shortDescription: Reusable membership registration review screen component.
fullDescription: Composes the new membership registration review interface shown before payment, including the step sidebar, personal data summary, contact and address sections, secondary membership cards, and footer actions. Reuses the shared button styles and can be embedded by any membership onboarding or account flow that needs a read-only review state for reference image 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg.

Renders a centered membership verification experience against a dimmed background, showcasing the shared MembershipVerificationDialog with member rows, verification status indicators, code entry boxes, resend links, and a final Done action for reference image 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg.

shortDescription: Reusable membership search and quick-action landing component.
fullDescription: Builds the membership management landing interface with a compact branded top bar, paired quick-action cards for new memberships and pending processes, and a centered search form for locating member records. It accepts reuse in future membership onboarding or CRM-like views that need the same lookup-first layout and visual hierarchy from reference image 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg.

Implements a compact modal for verifying multiple memberships by sending codes to saved contacts, listing each member with avatar, contact detail, verification badge or warning icon, four-digit code placeholders, resend links, and a primary completion button. The dialog is reusable in onboarding, household membership, or account confirmation flows that need the verification UI from reference image 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg.

shortDescription: Shared dialog primitive wrapper with optional built-in close control.
fullDescription: Wraps the Radix dialog primitives used across the application and now supports hiding the default close button through a hideCloseButton prop so branded modal headers can supply their own dismiss control while preserving the shared overlay, animation, and layout behavior.
